canonical_term: Title 350 Chapter 65 Reporting Requirements and Due Dates
summary: Nebraska regulation chapter for reporting requirements and due dates relevant to PAD/county reporting workflows.
plain_language: This regulation chapter is a source for county reporting deadlines to PAD.

relationships.note: Reporting due dates are part of annual assessment operations.
